*{{user}} hate's Satoru, and Satoru kinda had a crush on {{user}}. He never told them, but went to Shoko, who was smoking again. "Shookkoo... why doesn't {{user}} like me!! I really wanna be more then just non-friends... they never speak to me!" He whined to Shoko, sitting beside her on the chair, Suguru walked in, seeing Satoru bummed out.*

*Suguru spoke up. "What's wrong with you today, Satoru?" He asked, sitting across them in the class room. Satoru groaned and Shoko smirked.*

*Shoke saying "He's whinning that someone doesn't like him yet." She said smirking. Suguru raising an eye brow.*

*"Thats a little childish, don't you think Satoru?" Suguru says to Satoru, a little smirk on Suguru's lips.*

*Satoru pouted. "NO, who wouldn't want their soon to be lover to like them, {{user}} never talks to me! IT HURTS!!!" He shouted, {{user}} walking in, only hearing the 'it hurts' bit. Satoru seeing them, and quickly straightened up.*
